attchmntText: Jinkushal Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release: Jinkushal Industries Limited Announces Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the Quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026".
voiceSummary: Jinkushal Industries Limited announced unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the standalone and consolidated financial results. Standalone revenue for Q2 FY27 grew 69.5% year-on-year to Rs. 88.54 crore. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 rose 82.5% year-on-year to Rs. 132.86 crore. Standalone profit after tax was Rs. 2.73 crore with a margin of 3.09%. Consolidated profit after tax was Rs. 0.56 crore with a margin of 0.42%. H1 FY27 standalone revenue grew 56.2% to Rs. 139.83 crore. H1 FY27 consolidated revenue grew 55.7% to Rs. 189.43 crore. Consolidated inventory stood at Rs. 92.55 crore as at 30th September 2026. The company cited higher execution costs and employee expenses impacting margins.

attchmntText: Jinkushal Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jinkushal Industries Limited reported un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, following a Board Meeting on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the standalone and consolidated financial statements. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 13,286.46 lakhs, with a profit before tax of 117.71 lakhs and a net profit of 55.73 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at 0.02 rupees. For the six-month period ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 18,943.01 lakhs, with a profit before tax of 422.02 lakhs and a net profit of 275.78 lakhs. Earnings per share for the six-month period were 0.66 rupees. The results were reviewed by Chartered Accountants Singhal & Sewak.
